script_text: Cancer versus Libra looks easy, but September’s Uranus in Gemini squares a matching-degree Cancer Sun, shaking 4th-house security. Cancer is water-ruled by the Moon; Libra is air-ruled by Venus, blending feeling with charm. Cancer feels intrusive when Libra intellectualizes. Cancer’s Venus wants tenderness; Libra’s Mars wants autonomy in the 7th house. If Cancer’s Venus trines Libra’s Moon, dates feel affectionate; if Cancer’s Venus squares Libra’s Mars, care becomes control. Mercury in mutable signs aids adaptation, but Cancer hints and Libra debates rather than reassuring. Expect 10th-house career clashes and 2nd-house money fights when Cancer’s control replaces security. This can last with a natal Saturn–Venus trine or sextile, but only through mutual sacrifice. Without them, Cancer may cling while Libra retreats; Saturn in Pisces can square a 29° Pisces Moon, testing patience. One thing makes or breaks you: Cancer asks for reassurance, and Libra answers without disappearing. Comment your partner’s sign!
